from_snapshot.description:
Compute template snapshot to boot the new VM from instead of installing it clean.
Kolla then only reconfigures it; the template must match the farm's OpenStack
release, components and CPU architecture.

host_id.description:
Host for the new compute VM; omitted for the farm's primary host. A compute on
another host joins the farm through its link relay.

build_id.description: Revision the artifact was built from; empty for artifacts older than this field.

os.description: `linux`, `macos` or `windows`; agents recorded before this field are Linux ones.

supports_single_vm.description: Old installed agents remain usable for legacy inventory and deletion.

AgentHostToken.description: The new host and the token its agent connects with. The token is not shown again.

ArchiveMetadata.description: The metadata file written next to an exported archive.

computes.description: Compute VMs of the farm the snapshot restores; 0 for all-in-one and templates.

key.description: Object key of the archive this describes.

node.description: The VM a template was frozen from (`control`, `compute-1`, ...).

release.description: OpenStack release the guest was deployed with; unknown for older snapshots.

oneOf.description: `control` or `compute` for a template; absent for a snapshot of a whole farm.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the archive; imports refuse an archive that does not match.

AssemblyStep.description: One step of an assemble job.

job_id.description: The farm job that ran it; none for an import, which the snapshot shows.

node.description: The VM it makes (`control`, `compute-1`, ...); none for an import.

snapshot_id.description: The template it imports or boots from; none for a clean install.

Bucket.description: A registered bucket. Its secret key is stored encrypted and never returned.

ca_pem.description: PEM certificates trusted in addition to the system's, for a private CA.

endpoint.description: `None` for AWS S3, whose endpoint follows from the region.

name.description: Bucket name in the object store.

prefix.description: Key prefix archives go under by default; empty or ending in `/`.

message.description: What was verified: listing, writing and deleting under the prefix.

BucketIndex.description: `index.json`: every archive under the prefix with metadata, newest export first.

oneOf.description:
From the archive's metadata file; `None` for archives exported before those were
written, which can still be imported.

available.description: False while the service is listed for planning but cannot be deployed yet.

ComputeSize.description: A compute VM's size. Omitted fields keep the default compute VM's value.

disk_mib.description: Each container disk, 16384-524288 MiB; Nova keeps instance disks on Docker's.

memory_mib.description: Guest memory, 3072-65536 MiB; nova-compute, libvirt and OVS take about 0.8 GiB of it.

identity.description: `uname -srm` from the remote host. No credential material.

ConnectionTestRequest.description: One authenticated SSH check. Credentials are not stored.

oneOf.description: Size of every compute VM (see [`PlanRequest::compute`]).

computes.description: Compute VMs beside a control VM (see [`PlanRequest::computes`]).

expires_at.description: UTC Unix seconds. Metadata only in this version; no automatic deletion.

oneOf.description: A virtual GPU on every compute VM (see [`GpuConfig`]).

host_id.description:
Registered host that runs the farm: this machine's local host or a remote one.
Required; it is optional only so the error can say how to register one.

oneOf.description: VMs of a farm without computes (see [`PlanRequest::layout`]).

placement.description:
Compute VMs that run on another host than `host_id`, by VM (`compute-2` → host id).
Their links reach the control VM's host through the coordinator's relay.

snapshot_id.description:
Start from this snapshot instead of an empty VM. Its services replace `components`.
A control template starts a multi-node farm with its control VM alone, ready for
computes to be added; a compute template cannot start a farm.

Credentials.description: Write-only input. Never include this type in a host/job response or derive Debug.

Datastore.description: One published data store; ports are the host's, not the guest's per-start address.

databases.description: Databases a client can open, excluding MariaDB's own schemas.

credentials.description: Admin credentials; returned only by the explicit endpoints call, never persisted.

datastores.description: Data stores published next to the service APIs, for integrations.

bucket.description: Registered bucket to upload the archive to instead of keeping it on the coordinator.

key.description:
Object key in `bucket`, with `.msb` appended when missing; defaults to `<prefix><id>.msb`.
An existing object is not replaced.

path.description: Absolute archive path on the coordinator; defaults to `<state dir>/exports/<id>.msb`.

FarmInstance.description:
A virtual GPU instance as the portal's load editor lists it. `gpu_count` comes
from the flavor's resource class (or 1 when it asks for none, because the guest
script defaults to one virtual GPU).

applied.description: Whether the instance's metadata currently carries `farm_gpu_*`.

gpu_count.description: Virtual GPUs the flavor asks for, 0 when it asks for no GPU resource.

oneOf.description:
The load farm applied, or one decoded from the instance's metadata after a
coordinator lost its state.

properties.description: The `farm_gpu_*` keys currently set on the instance.

FarmLayout.description:
The layout of a farm without computes, kept readable for farms and snapshots made
before every new farm ran a control VM with computes.

index.description: A multi-node compute VM's position, from 1.

ip.description: Live eth0 IPv4 for new all-in-one guests; legacy nodes may retain an overlay address.

FarmOpenStack.description:
The OpenStack release a farm installs, named as the images and documents name it: the code
name beside the number (`2022.2` is `zed`), and whether this coordinator still supports it.

codename.description:
The series' code name for display, `Zed` for 2022.2 and `Caracal` for 2024.1; empty
when it has no published name. Display only: `series` keeps the name the images and
the upper-constraints path use.

eol.description: kolla-ansible keeps no branch for it any more, so it installs from the series' last tag.

series.description:
Its series name, `zed`; the same as `release` from 2023.1 on, where the names became
`year.release`.

supported.description:
False below the oldest supported release, whatever the host's
`FARM_ALLOW_UNSUPPORTED_RELEASES` says: such a farm keeps working but is out of support.

faults.description: Faults set on a multi-node farm's links, by VM (`control`, `compute-1`, ...).

gpu_loads.description:
Virtual GPU loads the portal applied, by Nova server UUID. The guest reads the
same values from instance metadata; this copy keeps the pattern the portal shows
after a coordinator restart. A farm restored from a snapshot recovers the load
from the instance's metadata instead.

shares.description: Other hosts that run some of a multi-node farm's compute VMs. `host_id` runs the rest.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot this farm was restored from.

step.description: Finer progress inside `phase`: our marker or the running Ansible task.

uplink_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the token `host_id`'s switch joins the relay with, for a farm with shares.

oneOf.description: Absent on a farm created before plans kept their release.

FarmView.description:
A farm as the API returns it: the stored record plus the release facts the portal labels the
farm with. Only the record is kept; the release comes from the release tables, so the names
live in one place and a farm's state stays what it was created with.

GpuConfig.description:
A farm's GPU: `count` virtual devices on every compute VM.

The `simulated` mode's provider layout is farm's own, so a request can describe the
contract another deployment's flavor expects: the resource class, the traits it requires
and how many cards the host has. `mtty` advertises what Nova finds and takes none of them.

devices.description:
Fake physical GPUs each compute advertises its virtual GPUs on, one child resource
provider each, as a vGPU host has one per card. Two devices make a flavor's request
land on a card rather than on a host. Omitted: one.

resource_class.description:
The resource class the flavor asks for. Omitted: [`DEFAULT_RESOURCE_CLASS`]. `PGPU`
and `CUSTOM_*` build another deployment's contract; the inventory is farm's either
way, so no driver checks it.

traits.description:
Traits the flavor requires besides the resource class. Omitted, `simulated` requires
[`DEFAULT_VGPU_TRAIT`]; `mtty` requires none, because Nova builds that provider.

GpuKernel.description:
What the guest kernel of a verification VM reported about the GPU stack. Every flag is
read inside that VM, so it says the kernel came up with the feature, not that the host
has a module for it: farm's kernel is built with VFIO and mdev included.

kernel_id.description: Installed kernel's id: the directory name under `~/.local/share/farm/libkrunfw`.

mdev_types.description:
Every mediated device type the guest kernel offers, as in
`/sys/class/mdev_bus/*/mdev_supported_types/*`.

mtty_registered.description: `/sys/class/mdev_bus/mtty` exists in the guest: the sample parent device registered.

reason.description:
Why the stock kernel booted although a kernel is installed, such as one built for
another msb.

vfio_mdev.description: `/sys/class/mdev_bus` exists in the guest, so the mdev bus registered.

GpuKernelKind.description: The kernel a verification VM booted: farm's installed kernel, or microsandbox's stock one.

GpuLoad.description:
The load a portal sets on one instance. farm turns it into a sample table and
writes it to the instance's Nova metadata; the guest script reads that table.
Nothing computes on the values: this exists to exercise monitoring paths.

memory_ratio.description: Share of framebuffer memory reported as used, percent.

GpuLoadView.description: One instance's load plus the metadata keys farm found on it.

properties.description: `farm_gpu_*` keys currently set on the instance.

GpuMode.description:
How a farm gets a GPU when the host has none. Both modes are virtual devices: no guest
sees a real GPU, and nothing computes on one.

GpuPattern.description:
How a virtual GPU's utilization moves through one period. farm samples the
pattern into a small table; the guest picks a sample from the current second, so
the guest needs no trigonometry and the portal's preview draws the same table.

GpuProfile.description:
The memory, power and clock envelope a virtual GPU reports. The guest derives
utilization, temperature, fan speed and the remaining clocks from its load sample
with integer arithmetic, so one profile name is all the metadata carries.

build_id.description: Revision this daemon was built from; a host agent must report the same one.

golden_image.description: msb snapshot new farms start from; the first farm on the host builds it.

relay_url.description: The relay farms that span hosts join through (`FARM_RELAY_URL`); none disables them.

custom_kernel.description:
`FARM_LIBKRUNFW_PATH` the host's agent boots farm VMs from, or the kernel host
preparation installed under `~/.local/share/farm/libkrunfw`; absent for the stock kernel.

custom_kernel_reason.description: Why an installed kernel was found but is not used, such as one built for another msb.

golden_image_available.description: This build's golden image is built; otherwise the first farm on the host builds it.

oneOf.description:
What the verification VM read from its own kernel about the GPU stack. Our kernel
carries VFIO, mdev and the `mtty` sample driver built in, so there are no modules to
load; these fields say whether those built-in features came up in the booted guest.
Absent until a preparation from a coordinator that probes them.

mtty_available.description:
The farm kernel ran the host's verification VM and exposed the `mtty` mediated
device type, which an OpenStack 2025.1 or newer `mtty` GPU farm binds as a vGPU.

delete_snapshots.description: A purge that also deletes the snapshots this host keeps.

HostKind.description: How the coordinator reaches a host's farm-agent.

HostShare.description: The compute VMs of a farm that one other host runs.

agent_sha256.description: The agent this host's part was created with, for a remote host.

uplink_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the token this host's switch joins the relay with.

Impair.description: Faults the switch adds to the frames from and to a port.

delay_ms.description: Added to frames entering and leaving the port, so a round trip gains twice this.

loss.description: Share of frames dropped in each direction, 0.0 to 1.0; 1.0 isolates the port.

ImportRequest.description: Import from an archive file, or from an object in a registered bucket.

bucket.description: Registered bucket holding the archive; requires `key`.

id.description: Snapshot ID to import as; defaults to the archive's file name.

path.description: Absolute path of a `.msb` archive on the coordinator.

assembly.description: The steps of an assemble job, in order, each with the job that ran it.

forget.description: A delete that removes only the coordinator's record and leaves any VM on the host.

remote_frames.description: Progress events of the host-side job already recorded here.

remote_job_id.description:
The host-side job a deploy runs as. It outlives the coordinator, which re-attaches
to it after a restart.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot captured by a snapshot job, or restored by a restore job.

steps.description:
Numbered steps of a job whose steps are known up front, such as a freeze, in the
order they started; the last one is current while the job runs.

target_host.description: Host that receives the VM of a compute-expansion job.

target_node.description: Suffix of the compute VM a compute-expansion job adds (`compute-2`, ...).

JobStep.description: One numbered step of a job.

failed.description: The job failed during this step.

NodeSnapshot.description: One VM's disks in a multi-node snapshot.

node.description: The VM it was taken from: `control`, `compute-1`, ...

NodeSource.description: Where a planned VM comes from.

container_disk_mib.description: Size of each ext4 disk backing Docker and containerd; `None` for nodes without containers.

index.description: Position among the farm's compute nodes, from 1; only multi-node compute nodes have one.

oneOf.description: The compute VMs' size when it is not the default.

computes.description: Compute VMs beside the control VM; 0 for an all-in-one farm.

disk_mib.description: Includes both container disks for each container host. Sparse disks consume less initially.

oneOf.description:
The virtual GPU every compute VM offers; absent on farms without one, and on plans
recorded before the option existed.

release.description:
OpenStack release the VMs install. Absent on plans recorded before it was kept, which
read as [`crate::kolla::OPENSTACK_RELEASE`].

oneOf.description: Size of every compute VM; omitted for the default. Only for farms with compute VMs.

computes.description:
Compute VMs beside a control VM, 1-3. A farm always runs Nova and Neutron; a
request with none is refused, as are the legacy layouts below.

oneOf.description: A virtual GPU on every compute VM; omitted for none. Not hardware: see [`GpuConfig`].

Layout of a farm without computes: read only, for farms and snapshots made before
every farm gained computes. New farms leave it out; [`require_multi_node`] refuses it.

release.description: OpenStack release to install; omitted installs this coordinator's own release.

PlannedNode.description: How one VM of a release farm will be made, and why.

key.description: Object key of a bucket template's archive.

node.description: `control`, `compute-1`, ... or `all-in-one` for a clean farm without computes.

snapshot_id.description: The local template it boots from; for a bucket template, the ID it is imported as.

RegisterAgentHost.description: Register a host whose agent will dial in.

RegisterBucket.description: Register a bucket, or replace a registered one's settings.

endpoint.description:
Origin of an S3-compatible service, such as `https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`
or `http://minio:9000`. Omit for AWS S3.

path_style.description: Defaults to `true` with a custom endpoint and `false` for AWS S3.

region.description: Signing region; defaults to `us-east-1`. R2 uses `auto`.

secret_access_key.description:
Required to register. An update without it keeps the stored key, unless the
endpoint, bucket or access key changes.

fingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint verified by the operator using an independent trusted source.

RegisterLocalHost.description: Register the machine the coordinator runs on as a host.

RelaySettings.description: Where farms that span hosts join, set from the portal or `PUT /api/v1/relay`.

url.description:
The relay as other hosts reach it: `https://<host>[:port]`. A quick tunnel's comes
from Cloudflare, so it is left empty.

RelayStatus.description: The relay as the portal shows it.

bind.description: Where it listens, with defaults applied.

ca_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the private CA's PEM, with private TLS.

listening.description: The address it listens on, once the daemon serves.

spanning_farms.description: Farms that span hosts; while any lives, the URL and mode stay.

oneOf.description: cloudflared, when the coordinator runs the tunnel.

url.description: The URL new farms that span hosts get: the settings', or a quick tunnel's address.

ReleaseCatalog.description: Releases a farm can be created with on one architecture, newest first.

unreachable.description: Buckets that could not be listed, with the error.

ReleaseCreateRequest.description:
Create a farm of an OpenStack release from saved templates: the control VM from a
control template, each compute from a compute template of the same release when one
can boot on its host, otherwise installed clean.

bucket.description: Registered bucket to also search for templates; omitted searches every bucket.

components.description: Services the farm runs; empty takes the control template's.

oneOf.description:
Size of the compute VMs this farm installs clean, and of the ones added to it later.
A compute that boots from a compute template keeps the template's size.

compute_hosts.description:
Host of each compute VM in order (`compute-1` first); a missing or empty entry is
the control VM's host.

compute_template.description: Compute template to use instead of the newest matching one.

control_template.description: Control template to use instead of the newest matching one.

oneOf.description:
A virtual GPU on every compute VM (see [`GpuConfig`]); only a clean install can take
one, because a template's VMs boot with the plan they were frozen with.

host_id.description: Registered host of the control VM. Required; optional only for the error message.

oneOf.description:
VMs of a farm without computes: `all-in-one` for one VM that runs everything, or
`control` for a control VM alone, ready for computes from compute templates to join
it later. Omitted keeps the previous behaviour (a control template starts its farm
with the control VM alone, a clean install runs all-in-one).

notes.description: Buckets that could not be searched, and other things worth knowing.

arches.description: CPU architectures its images are published for (`x86_64`, `aarch64`).

codename.description:
Code name of the series for display, `Caracal`; empty when it has no published name.
Display only: `series` keeps the name the images and constraints use.

eol.description:
End of life: kolla-ansible keeps no branch, so the release installs from its last tag
and only where its older images run.

installable.description: Whether this coordinator can also install the release clean.

series.description:
The series name the images and the upper-constraints path use: `wallaby`, or the same
`year.release` as `release` from 2023.1 on.

address.description: SSH address; `localhost` for the local host.

oneOf.description: `None` for the local host, which needs no credential.
Derived from coordinator reservations, not a live hypervisor limit.

connected.description: Whether a dial-in host's agent holds its connection now. Not stored.

port.description: SSH port, user and host key; unused for the local host.

copies_left.description:
Copies on other hosts that could not be removed, as `<host>: <error>`; they stay
on those hosts until removed there.

bucket.description: Registered bucket it was uploaded to.

path.description: File path on the coordinator, or `s3://<bucket name>/<key>`.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of an uploaded archive, as its metadata file in the bucket records.

SnapshotCopy.description: A snapshot copied to another host, where its agent keeps it as an msb snapshot.

reference.description: msb snapshot reference on that host.

arch.description: CPU architecture of the frozen guest; its disks cannot boot on another one.

oneOf.description: Most recent export.

copies.description:
Copies kept on hosts other than the original's, which farms and computes there boot
from.

deployed.description: Whether OpenStack was deployed when frozen. Restored farms then start `ready`.

host_id.description:
Remote host that keeps the original, which it was frozen on; `None` for the local
host, which keeps imported snapshots and every snapshot recorded before this field.

node.description: The VM a template was frozen from (`control`, `compute-1`, ...).

platform.description: Host OS that froze it (`macos`, `linux`); recorded for the operator, not enforced.

reference.description:
msb snapshot reference; set once captured or imported. A multi-node snapshot's is
its control VM's, and `nodes` holds every VM's.

release.description: OpenStack release the guest was deployed with; unknown for older snapshots.

source_exposure.description: Public ports the source farm's catalog was registered with; restores rewrite them.

source_farm.description: Farm the snapshot was frozen from; `None` when imported from an archive.

oneOf.description:
The one VM a template holds: `control`, which new farms start from without
computes, or `compute`, which expansions boot new computes from. None for a snapshot
of a whole farm.

id.description: Snapshot ID: 1-48 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.

node.description:
Freeze only this VM of a deployed multi-node farm as a template: a compute VM
(`compute-1`, ...) that later expansions boot new computes from, or `control`, which
new farms start from without computes.

SnapshotTransfer.description: An export to, or import from, a bucket in progress.

done_bytes.description: Bytes uploaded or downloaded so far.

total_bytes.description: Archive size; `None` while an export is still writing the archive.

TemplateRole.description: The VM a template snapshot was frozen from.

checked_at.description: UTC Unix seconds of the last release check.

connected.description: Whether cloudflared runs and has registered the tunnel.

unmanaged.description: `FARM_CLOUDFLARED` names the binary; it is not updated.

url.description: A quick tunnel's address, once Cloudflare gave it.

version.description: The cloudflared in use and the latest release last seen.
